stem: The histogram summarizes the waiting times, in minutes, of the 40 customers served at a pharmacy on one morning. Each interval includes its left endpoint but not its right endpoint. What fraction of the customers waited less than 15 minutes?
solution: The customers who waited less than 15 minutes are in the first three bars: \(6 + 10 + 12 = 28\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is \(\frac{16}{40}\), the fraction who waited less than 10 minutes. The 10-to-15 bar also counts.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is \(\frac{12}{40}\), the fraction who waited 15 minutes or more, not less than 15 minutes.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(\frac{36}{40}\), the fraction who waited less than 20 minutes. The 15-to-20 bar should not be counted.
explanation.D: Correct. \(6 + 10 + 12 = 28\) of the 40 customers waited less than 15 minutes, and \(\frac{28}{40} = \frac{7}{10}\).

verify:
n = sum(f for lo, hi, f in figure['bins'])
assert n == 40
fr = Rational(sum(f for lo, hi, f in figure['bins'] if hi <= 15), n)
assert fr == Rational(7, 10)
assert value(choices[answer]) == fr
assert all(value(choices[k]) != fr for k in choices if k != answer)
